The PR changes macOS node registration refresh from a one-second polling loop to event-driven refreshes and makes the status-label animation task sleep until the next idle animation deadline, with focused Swift tests and native i18n inventory sync.

PR surface: Other +130. Total +130 across 6 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for a source-level path: current main's Mac node loop still resolves config and permissions in the active loop, and the status-label task still wakes every 350 ms while animations are enabled. I did not rerun a signed macOS profiler capture in this read-only review, but the linked issue and PR include Time Profiler/process-sample evidence.
